basis: Dental agenesis and microdontia; classified as hereditary endocrine growth disease. Frequency and significance of strabismus and borderline cognition are unclear.
Non-syndromic intellectual disability; severe intellectual disability in 7/7 patients. No established metabolic organ dysfunction.
Disease of the adrenal endocrine gland; no additional organ damage applies across this umbrella.
Lymphoid malignancy arising in the mediastinum. Mediastinal location alone does not establish lung or cardiac involvement.
Sulfate metabolism disorder causing skeletal dysplasia and contractures; cleft palate in 8/12 (~67%). Blue sclerae alone do not establish ocular damage.
Retinal phototransduction dysfunction causes congenital stationary night blindness; no separate neurologic disease is established.
Inherited bone remodeling disorder with multiple sclerotic bone islands.
Defining intellectual disability, eye anomalies with visual impairment, and sensorineural deafness (80-99%). Associated leukemia is a separately diagnosed malignancy.
Immune-mediated inflammatory bowel disease; no common direct extraintestinal damage established for this subtype.
Hair and tooth ectodermal dysplasia: sparse hair, hypodontia and conical teeth in 5/5; hypohidrosis in 4/5.
Pulmonary valve stenosis and cafe-au-lait lesions define syndrome; developmental delay and pectus deformity each 2/3. Lisch nodules do not impair vision.
Aspergillus infection or fungal occupation of the lung; extrapulmonary dissemination is not intrinsic to this concept.
Skeletal abnormalities and intellectual disability define syndrome; bilateral cleft lip affects the mouth in 1/1 reported patient, with limited frequency evidence.
Leukocyte aggregates obstruct microvessels; pulmonary and cerebral injury are common major diagnostic manifestations of symptomatic leukostasis.
Chronic inflammation of the tympanic membrane; the concept does not establish an infectious or autoimmune cause.
Acquired destruction of cerebral tissue produces porencephalic cavities.
CNS hypomyelination with developmental impairment and seizures. Nystagmus reflects neurologic dysfunction without established primary eye damage.
Schwann-cell tumor originating in peripheral sympathetic nerves or plexuses.
Congenital skeletal myopathy with muscle-fiber abnormalities and elevated CK. Transaminase elevations do not establish hepatic injury; CK-MB alone does not establish cardiac injury.
NEB-related skeletal muscle disease. Respiratory insufficiency and feeding difficulty arise from muscle weakness; direct lung or gastrointestinal damage is not established.
Teratoma originating in the vulva, a reproductive organ outside the 13 axes.
Mitochondrial metabolic cardiomyopathy with arrhythmogenic myocardial lesions. Extracardiac abnormalities are occasional or very rare, below 30%.
Congenital hydrocephalus with brain malformations; chorioretinal coloboma in 2/4 (50%) supports ocular involvement. Cardiac abnormalities in 1/4 fall below threshold.
Disorder of the vertebral bones; neurologic injury is not inherent across this umbrella.
Squamous epithelial neoplasm originating in the vulva; classified as a reproductive organ neoplasm outside the 13 axes.
